definition: מַחְתֶּ֫רֶת noun masculine breaking in, burglary — יִמָּצֵא הַגַּנָּב ׳ אִםבַּֿמּ Exod 22:1 i.e. caught in the act ( J E ); so מְצָאתִים ׳ לֹא בַּמּ Jer 2:34 , not in the act of breaking in didst thou find them (2 feminine singular suffix Ges «GKC:44»§ 44 , 2, R 4), i.e. those whom thou hast slain were not detected in crime.
